invariants.rationale: The method uses 'profile' immediately and expects it to be non-null.
The method uses 'context' to retrieve small files; it should be non-null.
The method calls profile.getPartitionPaths() and uses it as a collection.
A collection's size is always >= 0; this is safe and captures structural property.
The method uses hasOutputWorkLoadStats() to conditionally reference getOutputPartitionPathStatMap(); ties their nullness/validity.
